Report
Depending on the configuration:

Memory
Abstraction
Interface
with
the
function
Fee_GetJobResult (job result set to MEMIF_JOB_FAILED).
 [SWS_Fee_00056] [SWS_Fee_00054] The error shall be reported
to
the
NVRAM
Manager
via
the
Callback
function
NvM_JobErrorNotification.
Recovery
See NVRAM Manager.
